major.summary: Future-dated Signals could consume the page cap or freshness aggregate before as-of filtering.
major.resolution: The revised contract requires repository-level capturedAt <= asOf predicates before pagination and before overall/per-kind freshness aggregation, with cross-provider regression fixtures containing more than six future rows.

major.summary: Measurement Action lifecycle-integrity disclosure lacked a closed vocabulary and precedence.
major.resolution: The revised contract defines action_missing, action_state_mismatch, action_version_mismatch and consistent in explicit precedence; consistent requires a measuring Action at the Plan action version.

minor.resolution: The revised contract requires explicit critical, warning, info precedence before capture recency and cross-provider tests.

do_not_change: Keep the summary provider-free and saved-records-only; do not add provider refreshes, a schema migration, or a separate MCP server.
Preserve the explicit non-atomic current-view disclosure and the 51-candidate Measurement overflow withholding rule.
